verseText: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death — even death on a cross.
meaning: Though Jesus deserved to be treated like a king, He chose to become a lowly human and suffer the dreadful death of the cross in order to save us.

recall.question: Jesus obeyed His Father even when it meant doing what?

meaning.question: What does it mean that Jesus “humbled himself”?
choices: He chose to serve, even though He deserved better

application.prompt: Jesus deserved to be treated like the greatest king of all, yet He chose to serve us instead. He was even willing to go through the worst in order that we might be saved. How could you follow Jesus' example and be a humble servant to someone you know?
